resources.string: Narrow the list by date, outcome, or archived. Archiving also offers Undo.
A session list opens its filter sheet and shows an archived session.

A dot marks a session whose latest turn ended after you last viewed it. Unread sessions sit in their own group below Pinned, so they are always at the top; open one to clear its dot and return it to its day, or mark them all as read from the group. In Settings → Sessions you can keep only the dot or turn unread sessions off.
A finished session gets a dot and moves to Unread; tapping it clears the dot and returns it to Today.
